dependencies.result: r32 positive-disjoint-basis Fourier estimate and weighted 2-edge stability

dependencies.scope_used: Only P(|Y-Y'|<=eps)<=2eps||p_Y||_2^2; challenged weighted-L2 compiler not used.

new_results.statement: For k independent original selectors and an arbitrary joint coefficient density g in L^p, with vartheta=1-1/p and alpha=k*vartheta, |phi_Q(t)|^2<=min(1,G*pi^alpha*B^(-vartheta)|t|^(-alpha)). Exact weighted-copy, L2, half-Riesz, square-transduced L-infinity and alpha>2 continuity thresholds are proved.

If a right-bank physical triple carries at least theta of the determinant energy m^2 in the exact angular packet, some coordinate j has |h_j|>=sqrt(theta/3)sqrt(beta^2+m^2), eta_j>=theta/3, and m*sqrt(eta_j)*|h_j|>=(theta/3)m^2.
In the exact angular packet, a triple carrying theta of determinant energy yields ||p_Q||_infinity<=96*sqrt(5)*theta^(-1/2)/s_3(A). Essential boundedness proved; continuity not claimed.

Combining r32 and the new near-triangle theorem: if delta>=1/64, density <67/s_3(A); if delta<1/64 and the stability alternative is near-triangle, density <263/s_3(A). Hence the only unpaid r32 collar is near-coloop.

unresolved_implication: In the exact angular packet, after the present non-coloop closure, handle a genuine physical row with eta_j>2/3 and simultaneous angular cancellation h_j=beta*v_j+m*q_j small or zero, using aggregation of the complementary nearly one-dimensional product bank. Full arbitrary-matrix reduction and full-target continuity also remain open.
next_step: Develop a near-coloop grouped-bank half-Riesz or direct small-ball estimate stable at h_j=0. In the exact-coloop limit all complementary (v,q)-rows are collinear; exploit that aggregate product projection rather than a single small pivot.
